capabilities.description: Generates and tracks Interim Payment Certificates and progress claims against BOQ items (P1-P5, E1-E5 from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx), applying Clause 14.3 retention (5% of each IPC, released in halves at Taking-Over and end of DNP) and Clause 4.2 performance security (10% of Accepted Contract A

Tracks time for completion (Clause 8.2, 730 days) and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7) from document:harbourline_contract.pdf, with clause-grounded evidence and a closed audit trail for each assessment.

Captures inspection and test plan (ITP) records, inspection outcomes, and quality evidence tied to BOQ work items (e.g., earthworks E1-E5 from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx), with evidence classification, verification, versioned records, and audit.

Maintains the project document register with versioning and diffs for contract, BOQ, drawings, and correspondence, ingesting files with provenance and hashing so each registered document is traceable to its source.

Grounds all platform answers and records in the contract excerpt (Clauses 8.2, 8.7, 11.1, 14.3, 4.2 from document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and the BOQ, refusing claims or calculations not supported by the source of record.

Displays a project commercial dashboard covering claim status, retention and security balances, delay-damages exposure against the 10% cap, QA/ITP status, and document register health for the Harbourline project.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that manages progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records, and a document register. It uses the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as the source of record, serving the project's contract administrator, commercial/QS team, QA engineers, and document controllers with clause-grounded, evidence-backed records for claims, damages, inspections, and document
